value.en: Book of Chen, Volume 19
value.literal: Book of Chen, Volume 19

value.zh: 沈炯 虞荔 弟寄 馬樞
value.en: Shen Jiong; Yu Li; younger brother Ji; Ma Shu
value.literal: Shen Jiong; Yu Li; younger brother Ji; Ma Shu

value.zh: 自天厭梁德，多難荐臻，寰宇分崩，英雄互起，不可勝紀，人人自以為得之。
value.en: From Heaven's loathing of Liang's virtue, hardships piled up, the realm split apart, heroes rose beyond counting—each thought he had gained it.
value.literal: From Heaven's loathing of Liang's virtue, many hardships piled up, the realm split apart, heroes rose one after another beyond counting—each man thought he had gained it.

value.zh: 然夷凶翦亂，拯溺扶危，四海樂推，三靈眷命，揖讓而居南面者，陳氏也。
value.en: Yet to level the barbarian and cut chaos, save the drowning and support the tottering, the four seas pushed forward, the three numina favored the mandate—who yielded and sat facing south was the house of Chen.
value.literal: Yet to level the barbarian and cut chaos, save the drowning and support the tottering, the four seas gladly pushed forward, the three numina favored the mandate—the one who yielded and sat facing south was the house of Chen.

value.zh: 豈非歷數有在，惟天所授，當璧應運？
value.en: Is it not that the sequence was fixed, Heaven alone bestowed it, the jade disk answered fortune?
value.literal: Is it not that the sequence was fixed, Heaven alone bestowed it, the jade disk answered the fortune?

value.zh: 其事甚明，一也。
value.en: The matter is very clear—first point.
value.literal: The matter is very clear—first point.

value.zh: 主上承基，明德遠被，天綱再張，地維重紐。
value.en: The sovereign inherited the foundation; his bright virtue spread far, Heaven's net was spread again, and Earth's cord was newly tied.
value.literal: The sovereign inherited the foundation; his bright virtue spread far, Heaven's net was spread again, and Earth's cord was newly tied.

value.zh: 夫以王琳之彊，侯瑱之力，進足以搖蕩中原，爭衡天下，退足以屈強江外，雄張偏隅。
value.en: As for Wang Lin's strength and Hou Tian's force—advancing enough to shake the central plains and contend for the realm; retreating enough to bend the strong beyond the Yangzi and spread might in a corner.
value.literal: As for Wang Lin's strength and Hou Tian's force—advancing they were enough to shake the central plains and contend for the realm; retreating enough to bend the strong beyond the Yangzi and spread might in a corner.

value.zh: 然或命一旅之師，或資一士之說，琳則瓦解冰泮，投身異域，瑱則厥角稽顙，委命闕廷。
value.en: Yet whether ordering a single column or relying on one scholar's persuasion, Lin dissolved like ice and threw himself into a foreign land; Tian touched horn, bowed forehead, and entrusted fate at the palace gate.
value.literal: Yet whether ordering a single column of troops or relying on a single scholar's persuasion, Lin then dissolved like ice, threw himself into a foreign land; Tian then touched horn and bowed forehead, entrusted his fate at the palace gate.

value.zh: 斯又天假之威，而除其患。
value.en: This again is Heaven lending prestige and removing their trouble.
value.literal: This again is Heaven lending its prestige and removing their trouble.

value.zh: 其事甚明，二也。
value.en: The matter is very clear—second point.
value.literal: The matter is very clear—second point.

value.zh: 今將軍以藩戚之重，東南之眾，盡忠奉上，戮力勤王，豈不勳高竇融，寵過吳芮，析珪判野，南面稱孤？
value.en: Now you, with a frontier kinsman's weight and the southeast's masses, exhaust loyalty serving above and join strength in diligent service to the king—is not merit higher than Dou Rong's, favor passing Wu Rui's, splitting jade tallies and judging fields, facing south and calling yourself solitary?
value.literal: Now the general, with the weight of a frontier kinsman and the masses of the southeast, exhausts loyalty in serving above and joins strength in diligent service to the king—is not merit higher than Dou Rong's, favor passing Wu Rui's, splitting jade tallies and judging fields, facing south and calling himself solitary?

value.zh: 其事甚明，三也。
value.en: The matter is very clear—third point.
value.literal: The matter is very clear—third point.

value.zh: 且聖朝棄瑕忘過，寬厚得人，改過自新，咸加敘擢。
value.en: Moreover the holy court discards flaws and forgets faults, is broad in gaining men; those who reform are all promoted in turn.
value.literal: Moreover the holy court discards flaws and forgets faults, is broad and thick in gaining men; those who reform and renew themselves are all promoted in turn.

value.zh: 至於余孝頃、潘純陀、李孝欽、歐陽頠等，悉委以心腹，任以爪牙，胸中豁然，曾無纖芥。
value.en: As for Yu Xiaoqing, Pan Chuntuo, Li Xiaoqin, Ouyang Wei, and the rest—all were entrusted with inmost heart, employed as talon and tooth; the breast was open without the slightest mote.
value.literal: As for Yu Xiaoqing, Pan Chuntuo, Li Xiaoqin, Ouyang Wei, and the rest—all were entrusted with inmost heart, employed as talon and tooth; the breast was open and never had the slightest mote.

value.zh: 況將軍舋非張繡，罪異畢諶，當何慮於危亡，何失於富貴？
value.en: How much more—your rising is not Zhang Xiu's, your crime unlike Bi Chen's—what worry of peril, what loss of wealth and honor?
value.literal: How much more is the general's rising not Zhang Xiu's, his crime unlike Bi Chen's—what worry of peril and extinction, what loss of wealth and honor?

value.zh: 此又其事甚明，四也。
value.en: This again—the matter is very clear, fourth point.
value.literal: This again—the matter is very clear, fourth point.

value.zh: 方今周、齊鄰睦，境外無虞，并兵一向，匪朝伊夕，非劉、項競逐之機，楚、趙連從之勢，何得雍容高拱，坐論西伯？
value.en: Now Zhou and Qi are neighbors in harmony, beyond the borders without worry; joining troops in one direction is not morning or evening away—not Liu and Xiang contending, nor Chu and Zhao joining—how may one sit at ease with hands folded and discuss the Western Earl?
value.literal: Now Zhou and Qi are neighbors in harmony, beyond the borders without worry; joining troops in one direction is not morning or evening away—it is not the moment of Liu and Xiang contending, nor the momentum of Chu and Zhao joining—how may one sit at ease with high hands folded and sit discussing the Western Earl?

value.zh: 其事甚明，五也。
value.en: The matter is very clear—fifth point.
value.literal: The matter is very clear—fifth point.

value.zh: 且留將軍狼顧一隅，亟經摧衄，聲實虧喪，膽氣衰沮。
value.en: Moreover General Liu glares wolf-like in a corner, repeatedly beaten, fame and substance wasted, courage decayed.
value.literal: Moreover General Liu glares wolf-like in a corner, repeatedly beaten and broken, fame and substance wasted, courage and spirit decayed.

value.zh: 高瓖、向文政、留瑜、黃子玉，此數人者，將軍所知，首鼠兩端，唯利是視；
value.en: Gao Zan, Xiang Wenzheng, Liu Yu, Huang Ziyu—these several, you know them: rats with two heads, seeing only profit;
value.literal: Gao Zan, Xiang Wenzheng, Liu Yu, Huang Ziyu—these several men, the general knows them: rats with two heads, seeing only profit;

value.zh: 其餘將帥，亦可見矣。
value.en: as for the rest of the generals, they may also be seen.
value.literal: as for the rest of the generals, they may also be seen.

value.zh: 孰能被堅執銳，長驅深入，繫馬埋輪，奮不顧命，以先士卒者乎？
value.en: Who can don hard armor and grasp sharp edge, drive deep in long march, tie horses and bury wheels, strive without regard for life, and go before the soldiers?
value.literal: Who can don hard armor and grasp sharp edge, drive deep in long march, tie horses and bury wheels, strive without regard for life, and go before the soldiers?

value.zh: 此又其事甚明，六也。
value.en: This again—the matter is very clear, sixth point.
value.literal: This again—the matter is very clear, sixth point.

value.zh: 且將軍之彊，孰如侯景？
value.en: Moreover is your strength like Hou Jing's?
value.literal: Moreover is the general's strength like Hou Jing's?

value.zh: 將軍之眾，孰如王琳？
value.en: Are your masses like Wang Lin's?
value.literal: Are the general's masses like Wang Lin's?

value.zh: 武皇滅侯景於前，今上摧王琳於後，此乃天時，非復人力。
value.en: The Founder destroyed Hou Jing before; the present sovereign broke Wang Lin after—this is Heaven's season, no longer human power.
value.literal: The Martial Emperor destroyed Hou Jing before; the present sovereign broke Wang Lin after—this is Heaven's season, no longer human power.

value.zh: 且兵革已後，民皆厭亂，其孰能棄墳墓，捐妻子，出萬死不顧之計，從將軍於白刃之閒乎？
value.en: Moreover after arms and armor the people loathe disorder—who can abandon graves, cast off wife and children, go forth on ten thousand deaths without regard, and follow you between white blades?
value.literal: Moreover after arms and armor, the people all loathe disorder—who can abandon graves, cast off wife and children, go forth on a plan of ten thousand deaths without regard, and follow the general between white blades?

value.zh: 此又其事甚明，七也。
value.en: This again—the matter is very clear, seventh point.
value.literal: This again—the matter is very clear, seventh point.

value.zh: 歷觀前古，鑒之往事，子陽、季孟，傾覆相尋，餘善、
value.en: Looking through antiquity and taking mirror from past affairs, Ziyang, Jimeng, overturn followed in succession; Yu Shan and
value.literal: Looking through former antiquity and taking mirror from past affairs, Ziyang, Jimeng, overturn followed in succession; Yu Shan and

value.en: (stone)
value.literal: (stone)

value.zh: 右渠，[12]危亡繼及，天命可畏，山川難恃。
value.en: Youqu met ruin in turn; Heaven's mandate is to be feared, and mountains and rivers cannot be relied upon.
value.literal: Youqu met ruin in turn; Heaven's mandate is to be feared, and mountains and rivers cannot be relied upon.

value.zh: 況將軍欲以數郡之地，當天下之兵，以諸侯之資，拒天子之命，彊弱逆順，可得侔乎？
value.en: How much more when you wish with several commanderies' territory to meet the realm's troops, with a feudal lord's resources to resist the Son of Heaven's command—strong and weak, obedience and rebellion, can they be matched?
value.literal: How much more when the general wishes with the territory of several commanderies to meet the realm's troops, with a feudal lord's resources to resist the Son of Heaven's command—strong and weak, obedience and rebellion, can they be matched?

value.zh: 此又其事甚明，八也。
value.en: This again—the matter is very clear, eighth point.
value.literal: This again—the matter is very clear, eighth point.

value.zh: 且非我族類，其心必異。
value.en: Moreover those not of our kindred—their hearts must differ.
value.literal: Moreover those not of our kindred—their hearts must differ.

value.zh: 不愛其親，豈能及物？
value.en: If one does not love his kin, how can he reach to things?
value.literal: If one does not love his kin, how can he reach to things?

value.zh: 留將軍身縻國爵，子尚王姬，猶且棄天屬而弗顧，背明君而孤立，危急之日，豈能同憂共患，不背將軍者乎？
value.en: General Liu is bound by the state's rank, his son married to a king's daughter—yet he abandons Heaven's kin, turns his back on the bright lord and stands alone—in days of peril, how can they share worry and not turn their backs on you?
value.literal: General Liu himself is bound by the state's rank, his son is still married to a king's daughter—yet he still abandons Heaven's kin and does not look back, turns his back on the bright lord and stands alone—in days of peril and urgency, how can they share worry and disaster and not turn their backs on the general?

value.zh: 至於師老力屈，懼誅利賞，必有韓、智晉陽之謀，張、陳井陘之勢。
value.en: When the army is old and strength spent, fearing punishment and coveting reward, there must be Han and Zhi's schemes at Jinyang, Zhang and Chen's momentum at Jingxing Pass.
value.literal: As for the army old and strength spent, fearing punishment and coveting reward, there must be the schemes of Han and Zhi at Jinyang, the momentum of Zhang and Chen at Jingxing Pass.

value.zh: 此又其事甚明，九也。
value.en: This again—the matter is very clear, ninth point.
value.literal: This again—the matter is very clear, ninth point.

value.zh: 且北軍萬里遠鬥，鋒不可當，將軍自戰其地，人多顧後。
value.en: Moreover the northern army fights a myriad li away; its edge cannot be withstood—you fight on your own ground and many look behind.
value.literal: Moreover the northern army fights a myriad li away; its edge cannot be withstood—the general fights on his own ground and many men look behind.

value.zh: 梁安背向為心，修旿匹夫之力，眾寡不敵，將帥不侔，師以無名而出，事以無機而動，以此稱兵，未知其利。
value.en: Liang An's heart turns away, Xiu Xu's strength is a single man—the many cannot match the few, generals cannot compare; the army goes forth without a name, the affair moves without opportunity—raising troops thus, one does not know its profit.
value.literal: Liang An's heart turns away, Xiu Xu's strength is a single man—the many cannot match the few, generals cannot compare with commanders; the army goes forth without a name, the affair moves without opportunity—raising troops thus, one does not know its profit.

value.zh: 夫以漢朝吳、楚，晉室穎、顒，連城數十，長戟百萬，拔本塞源，自圖家國，其有成功者乎？
value.en: As for Han's Wu and Chu, Jin's Ying and Yong—linked cities by the tens, long halberds by the million, uprooting root and blocking source to plot house and state—were there any who succeeded?
value.literal: As for Han's Wu and Chu, Jin's Ying and Yong—linked cities by the tens, long halberds by the million, uprooting the root and blocking the source to plot their own house and state—were there any who succeeded?

value.zh: 此又其事甚明，十也。
value.en: This again—the matter is very clear, tenth point.
value.literal: This again—the matter is very clear, tenth point.

value.zh: 孝惠皇帝諱衷，字正度，武帝第二子也。
value.en: Emperor Hui, whose personal name was Sima Zhong and courtesy name Zhengdu, was Emperor Wu’s second son.
value.literal: The Filial and Kind Emperor, taboo name Zhong, courtesy name Zhengdu, was the second son of Emperor Wu.

value.zh: 泰始三年，立爲皇太子，時年九歲。
value.en: In 267, when he was nine years old, he was named heir apparent.
value.literal: In the third year of Taishi, he was established as crown prince; at the time he was nine sui.

value.zh: 太熙元年四月己酉，武帝崩。
value.en: In the fourth month of the first year of Taixi, on the day jiyou, Emperor Wu died.
value.literal: In the first year of Taixi, on the jiyou day of the fourth month, Emperor Wu died.

value.zh: 是日，皇太子即皇帝位，大赦，改元爲永熙。
value.en: That same day the heir apparent ascended the throne, ordered a general amnesty, and adopted the reign title Yongxi.
value.literal: That same day the crown prince assumed the imperial throne, proclaimed a general amnesty, and changed the era name to Yongxi.

value.zh: 尊皇后楊氏曰皇太后，立妃賈氏爲皇后。
value.en: Empress Yang was elevated to empress dowager, and his consort Lady Jia was installed as empress.
value.literal: The empress, Lady Yang, was honored as empress dowager; Consort Jia was established as empress.

value.zh: 三月，平東將軍、齊王冏起兵以討倫，傳檄州郡，屯于陽翟。
value.en: In the third month Prince Jiong of Qi, general who pacifies the east, mobilized against Prince Lun, circulated a call to arms through every province, and camped at Yangzhai.
value.literal: In the third month, General Who Pacifies the East, Prince Jiong of Qi, raised troops to attack Lun, transmitted proclamations to the provinces and commanderies, and encamped at Yangzhai.

value.zh: 征北大將軍、成都王穎，征西大將軍、河間王顒，常山王乂，豫州刺史李毅，兗州刺史王彥，南中郎將、新野公歆，皆舉兵應之，眾數十萬。
value.en: Sima Ying, Prince of Chengdu and Grand General Who Campaigns North; Sima Yong, Prince of Hejian and Grand General Who Campaigns West; Sima Yi, Prince of Changshan; Li Yi, inspector of Yu Province; Wang Yan, inspector of Yan Province; and Xin, Duke of Xinye and General of the Southern Gentlemen-of-the-Household, all raised armies in response, mustering several hundred thousand men.
value.literal: General-in-chief who conquers the north, Prince Ying of Chengdu; general-in-chief who conquers the west, Prince Yong of Hejian; Prince Yi of Changshan; Inspector of Yu Province Li Yi; Inspector of Yan Province Wang Yan; General of the Southern Gentlemen of the Household, Duke Xin of Xinye—all raised troops in response; the hosts numbered several hundred thousand.

value.zh: 倫遣其將閭和出伊闕，張泓、孫輔出堮阪以距冏，孫會、士猗、許超出黃橋以距穎。
value.en: Prince Lun sent Lü He through the Yique pass, Zhang Hong and Sun Fu over the E ridge to block Prince Jiong, and Sun Hui, Shi Yi, and Xu Chao from Huang Bridge to stop Prince Ying.
value.literal: Lun dispatched his generals Lü He out of Yique, Zhang Hong and Sun Fu out of E Slope to resist Jiong, and Sun Hui, Shi Yi, and Xu Chao out of Huang Bridge to resist Ying.

value.zh: 及穎將趙驤、石超戰于湨水，會等大敗，棄軍走。
value.en: At the Ju River, Zhao Xiang and Shi Chao, serving Prince Ying, routed Sun Hui’s army, which broke and ran.
value.literal: When Ying’s generals Zhao Xiang and Shi Chao battled at the Ju River, Hui and the others were greatly defeated and abandoned the army and fled.

value.zh: 癸亥，詔曰：「朕以不德，纂承皇統，遠不能光濟大業，靖綏四方；
value.en: On the guihai day an edict began: “Lacking virtue, I yet inherited the throne, and I have not been able to extend the great enterprise or bring peace to the four quarters of the realm;
value.literal: On the guihai day, an edict stated: “I, lacking virtue, have succeeded to the imperial line; afar I have been unable to brighten and aid the great enterprise and pacify and soothe the four directions;

value.zh: 近不能開明刑威，式遏姦宄，至使逆臣孫秀敢肆凶虐，窺間王室，遂奉趙王倫饕據天位。
value.en: Near at hand I failed to make law and majesty clear enough to stop treason, so the rebel Sun Xiu could brutalize the court, tear at the royal house, and help Prince Lun of Zhao seize the throne by force.
value.literal: Near I have been unable to open and clarify punishments and might and check villainy and treachery, so that the rebellious minister Sun Xiu dared unleash cruelty and violence, spy on and divide the royal house, and thereupon supporting Prince Lun of Zhao greedily seized the heavenly position.

value.zh: 鎮東大將軍、齊王冏，征北大將軍、成都王穎，征西大將軍、河間王顒，並以明德茂親，忠規允著，首建大策，匡救國難。
value.en: General-in-chief who guards the east Prince Jiong of Qi, general-in-chief who conquers the north Prince Ying of Chengdu, and general-in-chief who conquers the west Prince Yong of Hejian are men of shining virtue and eminent kinship whose loyal counsel stood the test; they first devised the great plan that delivered the state from disaster.
value.literal: General-in-chief who guards the east, Prince Jiong of Qi; general-in-chief who conquers the north, Prince Ying of Chengdu; general-in-chief who conquers the west, Prince Yong of Hejian—all with bright virtue as flourishing kin, loyal plans truly manifest, first established the great strategy and rectified and saved the state’s crisis.

value.zh: 尚書漼共立大謀，左衛將軍王輿與群公卿士，協同謀略，親勒本營，斬秀及其二子。
value.en: Minister Cui framed the decisive plot; Wang Yu, general of the left guards, with the high ministers acting in concert, led their household troops into the palace and slew Sun Xiu together with his two sons.
value.literal: Minister Cui together established the great plan; General of the Left Guards Wang Yu, together with the host of dukes, ministers, and gentlemen, coordinated in stratagem, personally commanded the original camp, and beheaded Xiu and his two sons.

value.zh: 前趙王倫爲秀所誤，與其子等已詣金墉迎朕幽宮，旋軫閶闔。
value.en: The former Prince Lun of Zhao was deceived by Sun Xiu; he and his sons had already reached the Jinyong compound to bring me out of confinement and were turning their carriages toward the Changhe Gate.
value.literal: The former Prince Lun of Zhao was misled by Xiu; together with his sons and others he had already gone to Jinyong to welcome me from the hidden palace, turning the carriage at Changhe.

value.zh: 豈在予一人獨饗其慶，宗廟社稷實有賴焉。」
value.en: How could the blessing rest on me alone? The ancestral shrines and the altars of soil and grain have truly depended on them.”
value.literal: How could it be that I alone partake of the blessing? The ancestral temples and altars of soil and grain truly have relied on this.”

value.zh: 於是大赦，改元，孤寡賜穀五斛，大酺五日。
value.en: With the edict closed, the court ordered a general amnesty, a new reign title, five hu of grain for every widow, widower, and orphan, and five days of public feasting.
value.literal: Thereupon a general amnesty; the era name was changed; widowers, widows, and orphans were granted grain, five hu; great feasting for five days.

value.zh: 誅趙王倫、義陽王威、九門侯質等及倫之黨與。
value.en: Prince Lun, Prince Wei of Yiyang, Marquis Zhi of the Nine Gates, and the rest of Lun’s clique were put to death.
value.literal: Prince Lun of Zhao, Prince Wei of Yiyang, Marquis Zhi of Jiumen, and others, and Lun’s factional followers, were executed.

value.zh: 六月戊辰，大赦，增吏位二等。
value.en: The wuchen day in the sixth month brought a general amnesty and a two-grade promotion for every official.
value.literal: In the sixth month, on the wuchen day, a general amnesty; officials’ ranks were increased two grades.

value.zh: 復封賓徒王晏爲吳王。
value.en: Prince Yan of Bintu was restored to the old Wu princedom.
value.literal: Prince Yan of Bintu was again enfeoffed as prince of Wu.

value.zh: 庚午，東萊王蕤、左衛將軍王輿謀廢齊王冏，事泄，蕤廢爲庶人，輿伏誅，夷三族。
value.en: Prince Rui of Donglai and Wang Yu conspired to topple Prince Jiong; when the plot surfaced, Rui was reduced to commoner rank while Wang Yu and three degrees of his kin were executed.
value.literal: On the gengwu day, Prince Rui of Donglai and General of the Left Guards Wang Yu plotted to depose Prince Jiong of Qi; the affair leaked; Rui was deposed to commoner status; Yu submitted to execution; three clans were exterminated.

value.zh: 甲戌，以齊王冏爲大司馬、都督中外諸軍事，成都王穎爲大將軍、錄尚書事，河間王顒爲太尉。
value.en: Prince Jiong became grand marshal and commander-in-chief, Prince Ying general-in-chief with charge of the secretariat, and Prince Yong grand commandant on the jiaxu day.
value.literal: On the jiaxu day, Prince Jiong of Qi was made grand marshal and area commander for all military affairs within and without; Prince Ying of Chengdu was made general-in-chief and recorder of secretariat affairs; Prince Yong of Hejian was made grand commandant.

value.zh: 罷丞相，復置司徒官。
value.en: The chancellorship was abolished and the ministry of education revived.
value.literal: The chancellor was abolished; the office of minister of education was re-established.

value.zh: 己卯，以梁王肜爲太宰，領司徒。
value.en: Prince Rong of Liang was named grand steward while retaining the ministry of education on the jimao day.
value.literal: On the jimao day, Prince Xiong of Liang was made grand steward, concurrently heading the ministry of education.

value.zh: 封齊王冏功臣葛旟牟平公，路季小黃公，衛毅平陰公，劉真安鄉公，韓泰封丘公。
value.en: Prince Jiong of Qi's meritorious followers were enfeoffed: Ge Yu as Duke of Mouping, Lu Ji as Duke of Xiaohuang, Wei Yi as Duke of Pingyin, Liu Zhen as Duke of Anxiang, and Han Tai as Duke of Fengqiu.
value.literal: Prince Jiong of Qi’s meritorious subjects Ge Yu was enfeoffed duke of Mouping, Lu Ji duke of Xiaohuang, Wei Yi duke of Pingyin, Liu Zhen duke of Anxiang, and Han Tai duke of Fengqiu.

value.zh: 八月，河間王顒、成都王穎舉兵討長沙王乂，帝以乂爲大都督，帥軍禦之。
value.en: In the eighth month Princes Yong and Ying marched against Prince Yi of Changsha, whom the emperor named supreme commander to meet them in the field.
value.literal: In the eighth month, Prince Yong of Hejian and Prince Ying of Chengdu raised troops to attack Prince Yi of Changsha; the emperor made Yi grand commander-in-chief to lead the army in resisting them.

value.zh: 顒遣其將張方，穎遣其將陸機、牽秀、石超等來逼京師。
value.en: Zhang Fang came at the head of Prince Yong’s host, while Lu Ji, Qian Xiu, and Shi Chao advanced for Prince Ying against Luoyang.
value.literal: Yong dispatched his general Zhang Fang; Ying dispatched his generals Lu Ji, Qian Xiu, Shi Chao, and others to press the capital.

value.zh: 乙丑，帝幸十三里橋，遣將軍皇甫商距方于宜陽。
value.en: The emperor rode to the Thirteen-Li bridge and ordered Huangfu Shang to hold Zhang Fang at Yiyang on the yichou day.
value.literal: On the yichou day the emperor visited the bridge at Thirteen Li and sent General Huangfu Shang to block Zhang Fang at Yiyang.

value.zh: 己巳，帝旋軍于宣武場。
value.en: By the jisi day the imperial camp had withdrawn to the Xuanwu parade ground.
value.literal: On the jisi day the emperor wheeled the army back to the Xuanwu drill ground.

value.zh: 庚午，舍于石樓。
value.en: He spent the gengwu night at the Stone Tower.
value.literal: On the gengwu day he lodged at the Stone Tower.

value.zh: 天中裂，無雲而雷。
value.en: A fissure seemed to open in the heavens, and thunder rolled under a cloudless sky.
value.literal: The sky split midway; without clouds there was thunder.

value.zh: 河間王顒表請立成都王穎爲太弟。
value.en: Prince Yong asked the throne to name Prince Ying of Chengdu as heir apparent.
value.literal: Prince Yong of Hejian submitted a memorial requesting that Prince Ying of Chengdu be established as imperial younger brother and heir.

value.zh: 戊申，詔曰：「朕以不德，纂承鴻緒，于茲十有五載。
value.en: On the wushen day an edict began: “Fifteen years have passed since I, unworthy, inherited the great mandate.
value.literal: On the wushen day an edict stated: “I, lacking virtue, have succeeded to the vast line; here now fifteen years.

value.zh: 禍亂滔天，姦逆仍起，至乃幽廢重宮，宗廟圮絕。
value.en: Disaster has mounted to the skies, rebels have followed one after another, I was cast into the inner palace in disgrace, and the sacrifices nearly failed altogether.
value.literal: Calamity and rebellion have swelled to Heaven; traitors have arisen in succession, so that I was even confined and deposed in the deep palace, and the ancestral temples were cut off.

value.zh: 成都王穎溫仁惠和，克平暴亂。
value.en: Prince Ying of Chengdu is gentle, generous, and just, and he has crushed the violence that tore the realm.
value.literal: Prince Ying of Chengdu is warm, humane, kind, and harmonious, and has been able to pacify violence and chaos.

value.zh: 其以穎爲皇太弟、都督中外諸軍事，丞相如故。」
value.en: Let him therefore be named imperial younger brother and heir, commander of every army, while retaining the chancellorship.”
value.literal: Let Ying be made imperial younger brother and heir, area commander for all military affairs within and without, and remain chancellor as before.”

value.zh: 大赦，賜鰥寡高年帛三匹，大酺五日。
value.en: A general amnesty followed, three bolts of silk went to each destitute elder, and the capital celebrated for five days.
value.literal: A general amnesty; widowers, widows, and the aged were granted three bolts of silk; great feasting for five days.

value.zh: 丙辰，盜竊太廟服器。
value.en: Robbers plundered the ritual regalia from the Grand Temple on bingchen.
value.literal: On the bingchen day thieves stole the vestments and vessels of the Grand Temple.

value.zh: 以太尉顒爲太宰，太傅劉寔爲太尉。
value.en: Prince Yong moved from grand commandant to grand steward, and Liu Shi from grand tutor to grand commandant.
value.literal: Grand Commandant Yong was made grand steward; Grand Tutor Liu Shi was made grand commandant.

value.zh: 秋七月丙申朔，右衛將軍陳眕以詔召百僚入殿中，因勒兵討成都王穎。
value.en: On the bingshen new moon of autumn’s seventh month, General of the Right Guards Chen Zhen used an edict to summon the hundred officials into the palace hall, then led troops against Prince Ying of Chengdu.
value.literal: In autumn, on the bingshen new moon of the seventh month, General of the Right Guards Chen Zhen used an edict to summon the hundred officials into the palace, then led troops to attack Prince Ying of Chengdu.

value.zh: 戊戌，大赦，復皇后羊氏及皇太子覃。
value.en: Empress Yang and Crown Prince Tan were restored on wuxu under a general amnesty.
value.literal: On the wuxu day a general amnesty restored Empress Yang and Crown Prince Tan.

value.zh: 己亥，司徒王戎、東海王越、高密王簡、平昌公模、吳王晏、豫章王熾、襄陽王範、右僕射荀藩等奉帝北征。
value.en: On jihai Wang Rong, Prince Yue, Prince Jian, Sima Mo, Prince Yan, Prince Chi, Prince Fan, and Xun Fan convoyed the emperor north.
value.literal: On the jihai day Minister of Education Wang Rong, Prince Yue of Donghai, Prince Jian of Gaomi, Duke Mo of Pingchang, Prince Yan of Wu, Prince Chi of Yuzhang, Prince Fan of Xiangyang, and Right Vice Director Xun Fan and others escorted the emperor on a northern expedition.

value.zh: 至安陽，眾十餘萬，穎遣其將石超距戰。
value.en: The army swelled past a hundred thousand at Anyang, where Prince Ying sent Shi Chao to bar the road.
value.literal: When they reached Anyang the host exceeded one hundred thousand; Ying dispatched his general Shi Chao to resist in battle.

value.zh: 己未，六軍敗績于蕩陰，矢及乘輿，百官分散，侍中嵇紹死之。
value.en: At Dangyin on jiwei the imperial army collapsed, arrows riddled the imperial coach, the courtiers fled, and Ji Shao died shielding the throne.
value.literal: On the jiwei day the six armies were defeated at Dangyin; arrows reached the imperial carriage; the hundred officials scattered; Palace Attendant Ji Shao died in the engagement.

value.zh: 帝傷頰，中三矢，亡六璽。
value.en: The sovereign took three hits in the cheek and lost six of the dynasty’s jade seals in the rout.
value.literal: The emperor was wounded in the cheek, struck by three arrows, and lost six of the imperial seals.

value.zh: 帝遂幸超軍，餒甚，超進水，左右奉秋桃。
value.en: Starving, he fell into Shi Chao’s lines; Chao gave him water while attendants found late peaches.
value.literal: The emperor thereupon visited Chao’s camp, was extremely hungry; Chao advanced water, and attendants offered autumn peaches.

value.zh: 超遣弟熙奉帝之鄴，穎帥群官迎謁道左。
value.en: Shi Chao’s brother Shi Xi escorted the emperor toward Ye, where Prince Ying knelt with his entire staff along the road.
value.literal: Chao sent his younger brother Xi to convoy the emperor to Ye; Ying led the host of officials to bow in welcome by the roadside.

value.zh: 帝下輿涕泣，其夕幸于穎軍。
value.en: He stepped down from the coach in tears and spent the night in Prince Ying’s encampment.
value.literal: The emperor alighted from the carriage weeping; that evening he lodged in Ying’s camp.

value.zh: 穎府有九錫之儀，陳留王送貂蟬文衣鶡尾，明日，乃備法駕幸于鄴，唯豫章王熾、司徒王戎、僕射荀藩從。
value.en: Prince Ying’s compound already displayed the nine-bestowal regalia; the prince of Chenliu sent the full accoutrements of investiture, and on the following day the emperor entered Ye with complete state panoply, attended only by Prince Chi, Wang Rong, and Xun Fan.
value.literal: Ying’s headquarters held the regalia for the nine bestowals; the Prince of Chenliu presented sable-cicada insignia, patterned robes, and pheasant-tail pennants; the next day the full imperial equipage was prepared and proceeded to Ye; only Prince Chi of Yuzhang, Minister Wang Rong, and Vice Director Xun Fan accompanied.

value.zh: 庚申，大赦，改元爲建武。
value.en: The reign was renamed Jianwu on gengshen amid another general amnesty.
value.literal: On the gengshen day a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed to Jianwu.

value.zh: 八月戊辰，穎殺東安王繇。
value.en: Prince Yao of Dong’an was executed by Prince Ying on wuchen in the eighth month.
value.literal: On the wuchen day of the eighth month Ying killed Prince Yao of Dong’an.

value.zh: 張方復入洛陽，廢皇后羊氏及皇太子覃。
value.en: Zhang Fang returned to Luoyang and stripped the empress and crown prince of their titles once more.
value.literal: Zhang Fang again entered Luoyang and deposed Empress Yang and Crown Prince Tan.

value.zh: 匈奴左賢王劉元海反於離石，自號大單于。
value.en: Liu Yuan, the Xiongnu worthy king of the left who is known as Yuanhai, rose at Lishi and proclaimed himself great chanyu.
value.literal: The Xiongnu Worthy King of the Left Liu Yuan (Yuanhai) rebelled at Lishi and styled himself great chanyu.

value.zh: 安北將軍王浚遣烏丸騎攻成都王穎于鄴，大敗之。
value.en: Wang Jun, general who pacifies the north, hurled Wuhuan horse against Prince Ying at Ye and shattered his army.
value.literal: General Who Pacifies the North Wang Jun sent Wuhuan cavalry against Prince Ying of Chengdu at Ye and greatly defeated him.

value.zh: 穎與帝單車走洛陽，服御分散，倉卒上下無齎，侍中黃門被囊中齎私錢三千，詔貸用。
value.en: Prince Ying and the emperor bolted toward Luoyang in one cart, servants and luggage lost along the way; court eunuchs lent three thousand cash from their belts under emergency warrant.
value.literal: Ying and the emperor fled in a single carriage toward Luoyang; attendants and baggage were scattered; in haste high and low had no provisions; palace attendants and yellow gates carried three thousand cash of private money in satchels, and an edict authorized borrowing it.

value.zh: 所在買飯以供，宮人止食于道中客舍。
value.en: They bought meals from wayside kitchens, and the palace ladies slept in posting houses.
value.literal: Wherever they stopped they bought rice to supply him; palace women ate only at roadside inns.

value.zh: 宮人有持升餘糠米飯及燥蒜鹽豉以進帝，帝噉之，御中黃門布被。
value.en: One maid offered a bowl of gritty rice with dried garlic and salted beans; he ate it and slept under a eunuch’s quilt.
value.literal: A palace woman brought more than a sheng of coarse rice, dried garlic, salted beans, and fermented black beans for the emperor; the emperor ate them; he used a eunuch’s cotton quilt.

value.zh: 次獲嘉，市粗米飯，盛以瓦盆，帝噉兩盂。
value.en: At Huojia he bought two bowls of rough rice from a street vendor in a clay dish.
value.literal: Halting at Huojia, they bought coarse rice in the market, served in an earthen bowl; the emperor ate two bowls.

value.zh: 有老父獻蒸雞，帝受之。
value.en: An old man presented a steamed chicken, which the emperor accepted.
value.literal: An old man presented a steamed chicken, and the emperor accepted it.

value.zh: 至溫，將謁陵，帝喪履，納從者之履，下拜流涕，左右皆歔欷。
value.en: At Wen, intending to worship at the tombs, he lost his shoes, borrowed a guard’s pair, and wept so bitterly that every retainer wept with him.
value.literal: When they reached Wen, about to visit the mausoleum, the emperor lost his shoes, put on a follower’s footwear, descended to bow with streaming tears, and those at his side sobbed.

value.zh: 及濟河，張方帥騎三千，以陽燧青蓋車奉迎。
value.en: Zhang Fang met him mid-river with three thousand riders and a chariot hung with a bronze fire mirror and blue canopy.
value.literal: When they crossed the river, Zhang Fang led three thousand horsemen to welcome him with a sun-mirror canopy carriage.

value.zh: 方拜謁，帝躬止之。
value.en: Zhang Fang kowtowed, but the emperor raised him with his own hands.
value.literal: Fang bowed in audience; the emperor in person stopped him.

value.zh: 辛巳，大赦，賞從者各有差。
value.en: A general amnesty on xinsi came with graded rewards for everyone who had stayed with the throne.
value.literal: On the xinsi day a general amnesty was proclaimed; followers were rewarded each according to grade.

value.zh: 十二月丁亥，詔曰：「天禍晉邦，冢嗣莫繼。
value.en: On the dinghai day in the twelfth month an edict began: “Heaven scourges Jin, and no son of mine survives to succeed.
value.literal: On the dinghai day of the twelfth month an edict stated: “Heaven has punished the Jin state; no heir succeeds.

value.zh: 成都王穎自在儲貳，政績虧損，四海失望，不可承重，其以王還第。
value.en: Prince Ying proved unfit while heir apparent and has forfeited the trust of the realm, so he must be stripped of the succession and sent home to his fief.
value.literal: Prince Ying of Chengdu, while heir, failed in government; within the four seas hope was disappointed; he cannot bear the heavy charge; let him return to his residence as a prince.

value.zh: 豫章王熾先帝愛子，令問日新，四海注意，今以爲皇太弟，以隆我晉邦。
value.en: Prince Chi of Yuzhang, the late emperor’s favorite, grows in reputation every day, and he shall be named imperial younger brother and heir to steady the house of Jin.
value.literal: Prince Chi of Yuzhang was the late emperor’s beloved son; his fair fame grows daily; within the four seas all eyes turn to him; now let him be made imperial younger brother and heir to uplift our Jin state.

value.zh: 以司空越爲太傅，與太宰顒夾輔朕躬。
value.en: Minister of Works Prince Yue is appointed grand tutor to work beside Grand Steward Yong in guiding the throne.
value.literal: Let Minister of Works Yue be made grand tutor, together with Grand Steward Yong to flank and assist my person.

value.zh: 司徒王戎參錄朝政，光祿大夫王衍爲尚書左僕射。
value.en: Wang Rong shall join in supervising policy, and Wang Yan shall take the left vice directorship of the secretariat.
value.literal: Let Minister of Education Wang Rong participate in recording court governance; Household Grandee Wang Yan is made left vice director of the secretariat.

value.zh: 安南將軍虓、安北將軍浚、平北將軍騰各守本鎮。
value.en: Generals Xiao, Jun, and Teng are ordered to hold their existing commands.
value.literal: General Who Pacifies the South Xiao, General Who Pacifies the North Jun, and General Who Pacifies the North Teng each guard their original garrisons.

value.zh: 高密王簡爲鎮南將軍，領司隸校尉，權鎮洛陽；
value.en: Prince Jian of Gaomi becomes general who guards the south and acting metropolitan superintendent at Luoyang.
value.literal: Prince Jian of Gaomi is made general who guards the south, concurrently metropolitan superintendent, acting in authority at Luoyang;

value.zh: 東中郎將模爲寧北將軍、都督冀州，鎮于鄴；
value.en: Sima Mo moves to general who guards the north with Ji Province command, based at Ye.
value.literal: General of the Household Gentlemen of the East Mo is made general who guards the north and area commander for Ji Province, stationed at Ye;

value.zh: 鎮南大將軍劉弘領荊州，以鎮南土。
value.en: Liu Hong, general-in-chief who guards the south, keeps order in Jing Province.
value.literal: General-in-chief Who Guards the South Liu Hong holds Jing Province to secure the south.

value.zh: 周馥、繆胤各還本部，百官皆復職。
value.en: Zhou Fu and Miao Yin go back to their posts, and every minister returns to duty.
value.literal: Zhou Fu and Miao Yin each return to their original commands; the hundred officials all resume their posts.

value.zh: 齊王冏前應還第，長沙王乂輕陷重刑，封其子紹爲樂平縣王，以奉其嗣。
value.en: Prince Jiong ought long ago to have been sent to his domain, and Prince Yi suffered a cruel death, so enfeoff his son Shao as prince of Leping to preserve his line.
value.literal: Prince Jiong of Qi should earlier have returned to his residence; Prince Yi of Changsha was lightly subjected to heavy punishment; enfeoff his son Shao as prince of Leping county to continue his line.

value.zh: 自頃戎車屢征，勞費人力，供御之物皆減三分之二，戶調田租三分減一。
value.en: Because armies have marched again and again, palace supplies are cut by two-thirds, and the poll tax and land rent are each reduced by a third.
value.literal: Recently war-chariots have repeatedly marched, exhausting men and resources; articles for the imperial household are all reduced by two-thirds; household levies and field rent are each reduced by one-third.

value.zh: 蠲除苛政，愛人務本。
value.en: Harsh statutes are swept away so the people may return to their fields.
value.literal: Harsh government is remitted; the people are cherished and the root is sought.

value.zh: 清通之後，當還東京。」
value.en: Once peace is restored, the court will return to Luoyang.”
value.literal: After the realm is cleared and at peace, we shall return to the eastern capital.”

value.zh: 大赦，改元。
value.en: The edict ended with a general amnesty and a new reign title.
value.literal: A general amnesty; the era name was changed.

value.zh: 以河間王顒都督中外諸軍事。
value.en: Prince Yong of Hejian received overall command of every army.
value.literal: Prince Yong of Hejian was made area commander for all military affairs within and without.

value.zh: 壬辰，祁弘等與刁默戰，默大敗，顒、穎走南山，奔于宛。
value.en: On renchen Qi Hong and the others battled Diao Mo; Mo was greatly defeated; Princes Yong and Ying fled to the southern mountains and ran to Wan.
value.literal: On the renchen day Qi Hong and others battled Diao Mo; Mo was greatly defeated; Yong and Ying fled to the southern mountains and ran to Wan.

value.zh: 弘等所部鮮卑大掠長安，殺二萬餘人。
value.en: Qi Hong’s Xianbei troopers sacked Chang’an and killed more than twenty thousand.
value.literal: The Xianbei under Qi Hong’s command greatly plundered Chang’an and killed more than twenty thousand persons.

value.zh: 是日，日光四散，赤如血。
value.en: That day the sun’s light scattered blood-red in every quarter.
value.literal: That day sunlight scattered in four directions, red as blood.

value.zh: 甲午又如之。
value.en: The same crimson light returned on jiawu.
value.literal: On the jiawu day it was again so.

value.zh: 九月，頓丘太守馮嵩執成都王穎，送之于鄴。
value.en: Feng Song of Dunqiu captured Prince Ying and sent him to Ye.
value.literal: In the ninth month, Dunqiu Prefect Feng Song seized Prince Ying of Chengdu and sent him to Ye.

value.zh: 進東嬴公騰爵爲東燕王，平昌公模爲南陽王。
value.en: Sima Teng became prince of Dongyan and Sima Mo prince of Nanyang.
value.literal: Duke Teng of Dongying was advanced in rank to prince of Dongyan; Duke Mo of Pingchang was made prince of Nanyang.

value.zh: 冬十月，司空、范陽王虓薨。
value.en: Prince Xiao of Fanyang, minister of works, died in the tenth month.
value.literal: In winter, the tenth month, Minister of Works, Prince Xiao of Fanyang, died.

value.zh: 虓長史劉輿害成都王穎。
value.en: Liu Yu, Prince Xiao’s chief clerk, killed Prince Ying.
value.literal: Xiao’s chief clerk Liu Yu harmed Prince Ying of Chengdu.

value.zh: 永興元年春正月丙午，尚書令樂廣卒。
value.en: On bingwu in the first month of spring in Yongxing 1, Le Guang, Director of the Secretariat, died.
value.literal: In spring, in the first month of the first year of Yongxing, on bingwu, Le Guang, Director of the Secretariat, died.

value.zh: 成都王穎自鄴諷于帝，乃大赦，改元爲永安。
value.en: From Ye, Sima Ying, Prince of Chengdu, pressured the emperor by suggestion; a general amnesty followed, and the era name was changed to Yongan.
value.literal: Ying, Prince of Chengdu, from Ye hinted to the emperor, and so there was a great amnesty and the era name was changed to Yongan.

value.zh: 帝逼于河間王顒，密詔雍州刺史劉沈、秦州刺史皇甫重以討之。
value.en: Pressed by Sima Yong, Prince of Hejian, the emperor secretly ordered Liu Shen, Inspector of Yongzhou, and Huangfu Zhong, Inspector of Qinzhou, to attack him.
value.literal: The emperor was pressured by Yong, Prince of Hejian, and secretly ordered Liu Shen, Inspector of Yongzhou, and Huangfu Zhong, Inspector of Qinzhou, to attack him.

value.zh: 沈舉兵攻長安，爲顒所敗。
value.en: Liu Shen raised troops against Chang’an, but Sima Yong defeated him.
value.literal: Shen raised troops and attacked Chang’an, but was defeated by Yong.

value.zh: 張方大掠洛中，還長安。
value.en: Zhang Fang plundered Luoyang heavily and returned to Chang’an.
value.literal: Zhang Fang greatly plundered the Luoyang area and returned to Chang’an.

value.zh: 於是軍中大餒，人相食。
value.en: The army then suffered severe famine, and people resorted to cannibalism.
value.literal: At this, the army suffered great hunger, and people ate one another.

value.zh: 以成都王穎爲丞相。
value.en: Sima Ying, Prince of Chengdu, was made Chancellor.
value.literal: Ying, Prince of Chengdu, was made Chancellor.

value.zh: 穎遣從事中郎成夔等以兵五萬屯十二城門，殿中宿所忌者，穎皆殺之，以三部兵代宿衛。
value.en: Ying sent Cheng Kui and others with fifty thousand troops to garrison the twelve city gates. He killed everyone on palace duty whom he suspected and replaced the palace guard with troops from the Three Divisions.
value.literal: Ying sent Attendant Gentleman Cheng Kui and others with fifty thousand troops to camp at the twelve city gates; all those on palace duty whom Ying feared, he killed, replacing the palace guards with troops from the Three Divisions.

value.zh: 元皇帝諱睿，字景文，宣帝曾孫，琅邪恭王覲之子也。
value.en: Emperor Yuan, whose personal name was Rui and courtesy name Jingwen, was a great-grandson of Emperor Xuan of Jin and the son of Sima Jin, Prince Gong of Langye.
value.literal: The Emperor Yuan's taboo name was Rui, his courtesy name Jingwen; he was a great-grandson of Emperor Xuan and the son of Jin, Prince Gong of Langye.

value.zh: 咸寧二年生於洛陽，有神光之異，一室盡明，所藉槁如始刈。
value.en: He was born in Luoyang in 276, amid a strange glow that lit the whole chamber and left the bedding straw looking freshly mown.
value.literal: In the second year of Xianning he was born in Luoyang; there was a divine radiance anomaly; one room was entirely bright; the straw on which he lay was as if newly cut.

value.zh: 及長，白豪生於日角之左，隆準龍顏，目有精曜，顧眄煒如也。
value.en: As a man he bore a white filament beside the auspicious bump on his forehead, the high-bridged "dragon" profile of a ruler, and eyes so bright that every turn of his gaze seemed to flash with light.
value.literal: When grown, a white hair grew to the left of his sun-corner; high bridge nose and dragon countenance; his eyes had refined brilliance; his glances were radiant.

value.zh: 年十五，嗣位琅邪王。
value.en: At fifteen he inherited the title of Prince of Langye.
value.literal: At age fifteen he succeeded to the position of Prince of Langye.

value.zh: 幼有令問。
value.en: Even as a boy he was already known for an excellent name.
value.literal: In youth he had a fine reputation.

value.zh: 及惠皇之際，王室多故，帝每恭儉退讓，以免於禍。
value.en: Under Emperor Hui, when the house of Jin was rocked by one crisis after another, he habitually kept to modesty, frugality, and deference so as to stay clear of disaster.
value.literal: When it came to the time of Emperor Hui, the royal house had many troubles; the emperor each time was respectful, frugal, yielding, in order to avoid calamity.

value.zh: 沈敏有度量，不顯灼然之迹，故時人未之識焉。
value.en: He was steady, astute, and large-minded, yet never advertised his abilities, so his contemporaries failed to see the ruler in him.
value.literal: Deep and keen, with capacity for tolerance, he did not display glaring traces; therefore people of the time did not recognize him.

value.zh: 惟侍中嵇紹異之，謂人曰：「琅邪王毛骨非常，殆非人臣之相也。」
value.en: Only Ji Shao, the palace attendant, saw something different in him and told others, "The Prince of Langye has a presence no ordinary man possesses; that is hardly the look of someone born to serve another."
value.literal: Only Attendant-in-ordinary Ji Shao thought him strange, saying to people: "The Prince of Langye's bearing is extraordinary; probably it is not the appearance of a subject."

value.zh: 元康二年，拜員外散騎常侍。
value.en: In 292 he received appointment as supernumerary gentleman cavalier attendant-in-ordinary.
value.literal: In the second year of Yuankang he was appointed Supernumerary Cavalier Attendant-in-ordinary.

value.zh: 累遷左將軍，從討成都王穎。
value.en: He rose step by step to general of the left and marched with the army that moved against Sima Ying, prince of Chengdu.
value.literal: By stages he was promoted to General of the Left and followed in the campaign against the Prince of Chengdu, Sima Ying.

value.zh: 蕩陰之敗也，叔父東安王繇爲穎所害。
value.en: When the imperial forces were shattered at Dangyin, his uncle Sima Yao, prince of Dong'an, fell victim to Ying's purge.
value.literal: At the defeat at Dangyin, his uncle the Prince of Dong'an, Yao, was killed by Ying.

value.zh: 帝懼禍及，將出奔。
value.en: Fearing the blow would soon strike him too, he prepared to slip away from the capital.
value.literal: The emperor feared disaster reaching him and intended to flee.

value.zh: 其夜月正明，而禁衛嚴警，帝無由得去，甚窘迫。
value.en: The moon shone clear that night, yet the inner-palace cordon was so tight that he could find no way out and grew desperate.
value.literal: That night the moon was just bright, but the palace guards were strictly alert; the emperor had no means to depart and was very pressed.

value.zh: 有頃，雲霧晦冥，雷雨暴至，徼者皆馳，因得潛出。
value.en: Presently clouds swallowed the moon, a sudden storm broke, and the sentries scattered for shelter, which gave him the opening to steal out unseen.
value.literal: After a while, clouds and mist were dark and gloomy; violent rain and thunder arrived; the patrolmen all ran; thereby he was able secretly to go out.

value.zh: 穎先令諸關無得出貴人，帝旣至河陽，爲津吏所止。
value.en: Ying had barred every pass to people of rank; when he reached the Heyang ferry a petty official held him up.
value.literal: Ying had first ordered the various passes not to allow nobles to exit; when the emperor had reached Heyang, he was stopped by the ferry clerk.

value.zh: 從者宋典後來，以策鞭帝馬而笑曰：「舍長！
value.en: His follower Song Dian rode up behind him, tapped his mount with a riding crop, and called out with a laugh, "Innkeeper!
value.literal: Follower Song Dian came afterward, with a whip struck the emperor's horse and laughed, saying: "Hostel chief!

value.zh: 官禁貴人，汝亦被拘邪！」
value.en: The authorities are detaining grandees—have they got you as well!"
value.literal: The officials forbid nobles; are you also detained!"

value.zh: 吏乃聽過。
value.en: The clerk, fooled by the act, waved them through.
value.literal: The clerk then allowed passage.

value.zh: 至洛陽，迎太妃俱歸國。
value.en: He reached Luoyang, fetched his mother the grand consort, and escorted her home to his princedom.
value.literal: Arriving at Luoyang, he welcomed the Grand Consort and together returned to the state.

value.zh: 《書》曰：「唐虞稽古，建官惟百。」
value.en: The Book of Documents says: "When Tang and Yu looked back to antiquity, they created no more than a hundred offices."
value.literal: The Book of Documents says: "Tang and Yu examined antiquity; they established offices numbering only one hundred."

value.zh: 所以獎導民萌，裁成庶政。
value.en: That was how they encouraged the people and gave shape to the affairs of state.
value.literal: By this means they encouraged and guided the common people, and brought order to every branch of government.

value.zh: 《易》曰：「天垂象，聖人則之。」
value.en: The Book of Changes says: "Heaven displays signs; the sage patterns himself on them."
value.literal: The Book of Changes says: "Heaven hangs forth images; the sage takes them as his model."

value.zh: 執法在南宮之右，上相處端門之外，而鳥龍居位，雲火垂名，前史詳之，其以尚矣。
value.en: Justice lay to the right of the Southern Palace; the chief minister waited beyond the Duan Gate; bird and dragon offices held rank with cloud and fire as their emblems—prior histories lay it out clearly, and the grandeur speaks for itself.
value.literal: Law sat to the right of the Southern Palace; the chief minister took station beyond the Duan Gate; the Bird and Dragon offices held their posts, cloud and fire lending their names—earlier histories spell this out in detail, and the dignity of it is plain.

value.zh: 黃帝置三公之秩，以親黎元，少昊配九扈之名，以為農正，命重黎於天地，詔融冥於水火，則可得而言焉。
value.en: The Yellow Emperor created the Three Dukes to draw near to the people; Shaohao aligned the Nine Hu titles with agricultural oversight; Chong and Li received Heaven and Earth; Zhu Rong and Ming received fire and water—and such patterns can be put into words.
value.literal: The Yellow Emperor instituted the ranks of the Three Dukes to stay close to the black-haired masses; Shaohao paired the Nine Hu bird-names with the office of director of agriculture; Chong and Li were charged with Heaven and Earth; Zhu Rong and Ming were charged with fire and water—these arrangements can indeed be described.

value.zh: 伊尹曰：「三公調陰陽，九卿通寒暑，大夫知人事，列士去其私。」
value.en: Yi Yin said: "The Three Dukes harmonize yin and yang; the Nine Ministers track the seasons; grand officers attend to human affairs; ranked officers put private interest aside."
value.literal: Yi Yin said: "The Three Dukes harmonize yin and yang; the Nine Ministers watch cold and heat; grand officers understand human affairs; ranked officers rid themselves of selfishness."

value.zh: 而成湯居亳，初置二相，以伊尹、仲虺為之，凡厥樞會，仰承君命。
value.en: When Tang of Shang made Bo his seat, he first set up two chancellors—Yi Yin and Zhong Hui—and on every pivot they carried out the sovereign's will.
value.literal: When Cheng Tang ruled from Bo, he first created two chancellors and appointed Yi Yin and Zhong Hui to them; on every critical matter they looked upward to receive the ruler's commands.

value.zh: 總及周武下車，成康垂則，六卿分職，二公弘化，咸樹司存，各題標準，苟非其道，人弗虛榮。
value.en: Under King Wu and the models left by Cheng and Kang, the Six Ministers split the labor, the Two Dukes carried royal influence abroad, every bureau had its charter, and no one claimed idle honors without the right conduct.
value.literal: Altogether, when King Wu of Zhou stepped down from his chariot to rule, Cheng and Kang handed down norms; the Six Ministers divided duties; the Two Dukes spread transformation; each office kept its place and measure; if it were not the proper Way, people did not vainly seek glory.

value.zh: 貽厥孫謀，其固本也如此。
value.en: They anchored the dynasty by planning for generations yet unborn.
value.literal: They left plans for their descendants; thus they secured the foundation.

value.zh: 及秦變周官，漢遵嬴舊，或隨時適用，或因務遷革，霸王之典，義在於斯，既獲厥安，所謂得其時制者也。
value.en: Qin refashioned Zhou's bureaucracy; Han largely kept Qin's frame while tweaking it for the moment—the logic of strong rule was there—and stability meant institutions matched their age.
value.literal: When Qin altered the Zhou offices and Han followed the Ying-clan precedent, sometimes adapting to the times, sometimes shifting with practical needs—the norms of hegemons and kings lay herein; once stability was gained, this is what is called obtaining timely institutions.

value.zh: 四征興於漢代，四安起于魏初，四鎮通於柔遠，四平止於喪亂，其渡遼、淩江，輕車、強弩，式揚遐外，用表攻伐，興而復毀，厥號彌繁。
value.en: Han invented the Four Expeditions; Wei at its outset the Four Pacifications; Four Garrisons stretched toward distant peoples; Four Peace posts vanished when chaos returned. Epithets like Crossing-the-Liao, River-Fording, light chariot, and strong crossbow brandished force beyond the borders for campaigns—created, scrapped, then multiplied until the catalogue grew tangled.
value.literal: The Four Expeditions arose in Han; the Four Pacifications began at the start of Wei; the Four Garrisons reached outward to soothe the distant; the Four Peace offices ended with turmoil and disorder; as for Crossing-the-Liao, River-Fording, light chariot, and strong crossbow—they displayed might afar and signaled campaigns—raised up and then abolished, their titles grew ever more numerous.

value.zh: 及當塗得志，克平諸夏，初有軍師祭酒，參掌戎律。
value.en: Once the Cao regime triumphed and pacified the heartland, it introduced the army adviser libationer to share oversight of military law.
value.literal: When the house at Dangtu achieved its ambition and subdued the Central Plain, there first appeared the army adviser libationer, who jointly handled military regulations.

value.zh: 建安十三年，罷漢台司，更置丞相，而以曹公居之，用兼端揆。
value.en: In the thirteenth year of Jian'an (208), the Han ministerial posts were abolished, the chancellorship was reinstated, and Lord Cao held it, thereby combining the highest civil authority.
value.literal: In the thirteenth year of Jian'an, the Han terrace ministers were abolished; the chancellor was reinstated, and Lord Cao held it, thereby combining the highest civil authority.

value.zh: 孫吳、劉蜀，多依漢制，雖復臨時命氏，而無忝舊章。
value.en: Wu and Shu largely kept Han models; occasional improvised titles notwithstanding, they stayed within the classical mold.
value.literal: Eastern Wu and Liu Bei's Shu largely followed Han institutions; though they sometimes improvised titles on the spot, they did not shame the old statutes.

value.zh: 世祖武皇帝即位之初，以安平王孚為太宰，鄭沖為太傅，王祥為太保，司馬望為太尉，何曾為司徒，荀顗為司空，石苞為大司馬，陳騫為大將軍，世所謂八公同辰，攀雲附翼者也。
value.en: At his accession, Emperor Wu named Sima Fu Grand Preceptor, Zheng Chong Grand Tutor, Wang Xiang Grand Guardian, Sima Wang Minister of War, He Zeng Minister of Education, Xun Yi Minister of Works, Shi Bao Grand Marshal, and Chen Qian Grand General—the storied eight dukes of a single hour, men who rose by riding imperial favor.
value.literal: When Emperor Wu the Shizu first ascended the throne, he appointed Prince Fu of Anping as Grand Preceptor, Zheng Chong as Grand Tutor, Wang Xiang as Grand Guardian, Sima Wang as Minister of War, He Zeng as Minister of Education, Xun Yi as Minister of Works, Shi Bao as Grand Marshal, and Chen Qian as Grand General—what the age called the eight dukes sharing one hour, climbing clouds and attaching wings.

value.zh: 若乃成乎棟宇，非一枝之勢；
value.en: Raising the whole hall takes more than one timber;
value.literal: As for completing roof-beams and rafters—it is not the strength of a single branch;

value.zh: 處乎經綸，稱萬夫之敵。
value.en: true stewardship of the realm earns the title match for ten thousand.
value.literal: to dwell in ordering the realm is to be called a match for ten thousand men.

value.zh: 或牽羊以葉於夢，或垂釣以申其道，或空桑以獻其術，或操版以啟其心。
value.en: Some arrived through dreams of sheep and grain; some through fishing metaphors; some from humble soil with a craft to sell; some by presenting the royal tablet and winning trust.
value.literal: Some led sheep and answered a leaf in a dream; some angled with a hook to proclaim their Way; some offered their arts from an empty mulberry; some grasped the tablet to open the ruler's mind.

value.zh: 臥龍飛鴻，方金擬璧，秦奚、鄭產，楚材晉用，斯亦曩時之良具，其又昭彰者焉。
value.en: Hidden dragons and soaring swans, talents weighed like gold against jade—Qin Xi, Zheng Chan, and Chu talent employed by Jin: these too were fine instruments of former times, and no less manifest.
value.literal: The sleeping dragon, the soaring wild goose—square metal compared to round jade; the shepherd of Qin, the prodigy of Zheng; Chu talent employed by Jin—these too were fine instruments of former times, and no less manifest.

value.zh: 宣王既誅曹爽，政由己出，網羅英俊，以備天官。
value.en: After Sima Yi eliminated Cao Shuang, he ruled in his own name and stocked every court post with talent.
value.literal: Once Prince Xuan had executed Cao Shuang, government proceeded from himself alone; he gathered capable men to fill the celestial offices.

value.zh: 及蘭卿受羈，貴公顯戮，雖復策名魏氏，而乃心皇晉。
value.en: When fine officers were seized and great nobles died in public execution, names might still stand with Wei but hearts had already turned to Jin.
value.literal: When worthy ministers were placed under restraint and eminent dukes suffered public execution—though they still bore registration under the Wei, their hearts were with the august Jin.

value.zh: 及文王纂業，初啟晉台，始置二衛，有前驅養由之弩；
value.en: When Sima Zhao extended the family work and founded the Jin apparatus, he created the Two Guards with vanguard crossbows worthy of Yang Youji.
value.literal: When King Wen continued the enterprise and first opened the Jin terrace, he began setting up the Two Guards, including front-vanguard crossbows like Yang Youji's.

value.zh: 及設三部，有熊渠佽飛之眾。
value.en: When the Three Corps were established, there were masses like those of Xiong Qu and Ci Fei.
value.literal: When the Three Departments were established, there were masses like the royal swimmers of Xiong Qu.

value.zh: 是以武帝龍飛，乘茲奮翼，猶武王以周之十亂而理殷民者也。
value.en: Thus Emperor Wu's rise—vaulting on these preparations—matched King Wu deploying his ten able assistants to rule the former Shang subjects.
value.literal: Therefore when Emperor Wu ascended like a dragon, riding this to beat his wings, it was like King Wu of Zhou using the Zhou's ten ministers to govern the Yin people.

value.zh: 是以泰始盡于太康，喬柯茂葉，來居斯位；
value.en: From the Taishi era through Taikang, imposing figures filled those ranks;
value.literal: Thus from Taishi through Taikang, tall trees with lush foliage came to occupy these posts;

value.zh: 自太興訖於建元，南金北銑，用處茲秩。
value.en: from Daxing to Jianyuan, the finest metal south and north filled those offices.
value.literal: from Daxing down to Jianyuan, southern gold and northern ore were employed in these ranks.

value.zh: 雖未擬乎夔拊龍言，天工人代，亦庶幾乎任官惟賢，蒞事惟能者也。
value.en: They fell short of the sage-kings' marriage of Heaven's work to human agency, yet they neared the ideal: office by virtue, tasks by competence.
value.literal: Though they did not equal Kui's drumming and Long's pronouncements—Heaven's work and man's substitute—they approximated appoint officials only for worth, approach affairs only by ability.

value.zh: 丞相、相國，並秦官也。
value.en: The titles chancellor and minister of state both originated in Qin.
value.literal: Chancellor and minister of state were both Qin offices.

value.zh: 晉受魏禪，並不置，自惠帝之後，省置無恆。
value.en: Jin left both vacant at the founding; after Emperor Hui the posts flickered in and out without a fixed rule.
value.literal: When Jin received Wei's abdication, neither was established; from Emperor Hui onward, abolition and establishment were not constant.

value.zh: 為之者，趙王倫、梁王肜、成都王穎、南陽王保、王敦、王導之徒，皆非復尋常人臣之職。
value.en: When princes such as Sima Lun, Sima Rong, Sima Ying, Sima Bao, Wang Dun, and Wang Dao took these titles, they wielded power far beyond an ordinary subject's charge.
value.literal: Those who held them—Zhao Wang Lun, Liang Wang Rong, Chengdu Wang Ying, Nanyang Wang Bao, Wang Dun, Wang Dao, and the like—were no longer the duties of ordinary ministers.

value.zh: 安平獻王孚
value.en: Prince Xian of Anping, Sima Fu.
value.literal: Prince Fu of Anping with posthumous title Xian (section heading).

value.zh: 楙善諂諛，曲事楊駿。
value.en: Sima Mao excelled at sycophancy and curried favor with Yang Jun.
value.literal: Mao was skilled at flattery and fawning and bent his service to Yang Jun.

value.zh: 及駿誅，依法當死，東安公繇與楙善，故得不坐。
value.en: Jun's fall should have cost Mao his life, yet Sima You's friendship shielded him.
value.literal: When Jun was executed, by law Mao ought to have died, but Duke of Dongan You was friendly with Mao, so he avoided punishment.

value.zh: 尋遷大鴻臚，加侍中。
value.en: He soon rose to grand herald with supernumerary palace attendant rank.
value.literal: Soon he was promoted Grand Herald and added palace attendant.

value.zh: 繇欲擅朝政，與汝南王亮不平。
value.en: Sima You grasped for centralized power and clashed with Prince Liang of Runan.
value.literal: You wished to monopolize court government and was at odds with Prince Liang of Runan.

value.zh: 帝托以繇討駿顧望，免繇、楙等官，遣楙就國。
value.en: Emperor Hui blamed Sima You for half-hearted action against Jun, cashiered both men, and banished Mao to his domain.
value.literal: The emperor on the pretext that You hesitated in attacking Jun removed You and Mao from office and sent Mao to his fief.

value.zh: 楙殖財貨，奢僭逾制。
value.en: He hoarded treasure and flouted sumptuary law with pretensions beyond his rank.
value.literal: Mao amassed wealth and goods; extravagance and usurpation of ritual exceeded regulations.

value.zh: 趙王倫篡位，召還。
value.en: Sima Lun's coup brought Mao back to court.
value.literal: When Prince Zhao Lun usurped the throne he recalled Mao.

value.zh: 及義兵起，倫以楙為衛將軍、都督諸軍事。
value.en: Once loyalist armies rose Lun named Mao metropolitan guard and overall commander.
value.literal: When the righteous host rose, Lun appointed Mao General Who Guards the Metropolis and supervisor of all military affairs.

value.zh: 倫敗，楙免官。
value.en: Lun's fall stripped Mao of his posts.
value.literal: When Lun was defeated Mao was dismissed from office.

value.zh: 齊王冏輔政，繇復為僕射，舉楙為平東將軍、都督徐州諸軍事，鎮下邳。
value.en: Under Sima Jiong's regency Sima You returned as vice director and nominated Mao as pacifier-general for Xu based at Xiapi.
value.literal: When Prince of Qi Jiong assisted government You again became vice director and recommended Mao as General Who Pacifies the East and supervisor of Xu military affairs, stationed at Xiapi.

value.zh: 成都王穎輔政，進楙為衛將軍。
value.en: Sima Ying's turn at power promoted Mao to metropolitan guard.
value.literal: When Prince of Chengdu Ying assisted government Mao was advanced to General Who Guards the Metropolis.

value.zh: 新蔡武哀王騰，字元邁，少拜冗從僕射，封東嬴公，曆南陽、魏郡太守，所在稱職，徵為宗正，遷太常，轉持節、寧北將軍、都督并州諸軍事、并州刺史。
value.en: Sima Teng, Prince Wuai of Xincai, courtesy name Yuanmai, was appointed Supernumerary Cavalier Attendant when young and enfeoffed as Duke of Dongying. He served successively as governor of Nanyang and Wei Commandery, was praised as competent wherever he served, was summoned as Director of the Imperial Clan, promoted to Minister of Ceremonies, and then transferred as Bearer of the Staff, General Who Pacifies the North, commander of all military affairs in Bing Province, and inspector of Bing Province.
value.literal: Prince Wuai of Xincai Teng courtesy Yuanmai in youth was appointed supernumerary chariot master and enfeoffed Duke of Dongying; successively governor of Nanyang and Wei commandery where he was praised competent; summoned Grand Director of the Imperial Clan; promoted Minister of Ceremonies; transferred credential-bearing Pacifying North General supervising Bing military affairs and Bing Inspector.

value.zh: 惠帝討成都王穎，六軍敗績。
value.en: Hui's expedition against Sima Ying collapsed.
value.literal: When Emperor Hui campaigned against Prince of Chengdu Ying the six armies were routed.

value.zh: 騰與安北將軍王浚共殺穎所署幽州刺史和演，率眾討穎。
value.en: Teng joined Wang Jun executing He Yan then marched on Ying.
value.literal: Teng together with Pacifying North General Wang Jun jointly killed Inspector of You appointed by Ying—He Yan—and led hosts against Ying.

value.zh: 穎遣北中郎將王斌距戰，浚率鮮卑騎擊斌，騰為後系，大破之。
value.en: Xianbei cavalry under Wang Jun shattered Wang Bin while Teng held the rear.
value.literal: Ying dispatched Northern Gentlemen General Wang Bin to resist; Jun led Xianbei horse striking Bin while Teng covered the rear routing them utterly.

value.zh: 穎懼，挾帝歸洛陽，進騰位安北將軍。
value.en: Ying was afraid and took Emperor Hui back to Luoyang; Teng was promoted to General Who Pacifies the North.
value.literal: Ying feared and escorted the emperor back to Luoyang; Teng was advanced Pacifying North General.

value.zh: 永嘉初，遷車騎將軍，都督鄴城守諸軍事，鎮鄴。
value.en: Yongjia named him chariot-and-cavalry chief at Ye.
value.literal: Early Yongjia he was promoted chariot-and-cavalry general supervising Ye garrison stationed at Ye.

value.zh: 又以迎駕之勳，改封新蔡王。
value.en: Welcoming the throne earned the Xincai princedom.
value.literal: Again for merit welcoming the imperial carriage his enfeoffment was changed Prince of Xincai.

value.zh: 初，騰發并州，次於真定。
value.en: Leaving Bing he paused at Zhending.
value.literal: At first when Teng set out from Bing Province he halted at Zhending.

value.zh: 值大雪，平地數尺，營門前方數丈雪融不積，騰怪而掘之，得玉馬，高尺許，表獻之。
value.en: Snow melted oddly at his gate; digging revealed a jade horse sent to court.
value.literal: It happened there was great snow several chi deep on level ground; before the camp gate several zhang of ground showed melted snow not accumulating; Teng wondered and dug obtaining a jade horse about a chi high which he memorialized and presented.

value.zh: 其後公師籓與平陽人汲桑等為群盜，起於清河鄃縣，眾千餘人，寇頓丘，以葬成都王穎為辭，載穎主而行，與張泓故將李豐等將攻鄴。
value.en: Ji Sang's gang marched under Ying's tablet to threaten Ye.
value.literal: Later duke-lord Shi Fan with Pingyang men Ji Sang and others formed bandit gangs rising in Shu county of Qinghe over one thousand strong raiding Dunqiu using burying Prince of Chengdu Ying as pretext loading Ying's spirit tablet marching with Zhang Hong's old general Li Feng intending to attack Ye.

value.zh: 騰曰：「孤在并州七年，胡圍城不能克。
value.en: Teng said, 'I was at Bing seven years and barbarians besieging the city could not overcome it.
value.literal: Teng said, 'I was at Bing seven years and barbarians besieging the city could not overcome it.

value.zh: 汲桑小賊，何足憂也。」
value.en: Ji Sang petty bandits—what worth worry.'
value.literal: Ji Sang petty bandits—what worth worry.'

value.zh: 及豐等至，騰不能守，率輕騎而走，為豐所害。
value.en: The raid overwhelmed him; fleeing lightly armed he fell to Feng.
value.literal: When Feng and others arrived Teng could not defend and led light horse fleeing and was killed by Feng.

value.zh: 四子：虞、矯、紹、確。
value.en: Four sons survived: Yu, Jiao, Shao, Que.
value.literal: Four sons: Yu, Jiao, Shao, Que.

value.zh: 虞有勇力，騰之被害，虞逐豐，豐投水而死。
value.en: Yu avenged his father driving Feng into the river.
value.literal: Yu had courage and strength; when Teng was harmed Yu pursued Feng who threw himself in water and died.

value.zh: 是日，虞及矯、紹並钜鹿太守崔曼、車騎長史羊恆、從事中郎蔡克等又為豐餘黨所害，及諸名家流移依鄴者，死亡並盡。
value.en: The bloodbath wiped Julu officials and refugee clans at Ye.
value.literal: That same day Yu together with Jiao and Shao and Julu governor Cui Man chariot-and-cavalry chief clerk Yang Heng consultant Cai Ke were again harmed by Feng's remaining faction and renowned families taking refuge at Ye perished altogether.

value.zh: 初，鄴中雖府庫虛竭，而騰資用甚饒。
value.en: Ye's arsenals stood empty yet Teng hoarded wealth.
value.literal: At first though Ye granaries were exhausted Teng's private wealth was very ample.

value.zh: 性儉嗇，無所振惠，臨急，乃賜將士米可數升，帛各丈尺，是以人不為用，遂致於禍。
value.en: His miserly handfuls of grain and cloth bought no loyalty and brought disaster.
value.literal: By nature stingy he showed no generosity; facing crisis he then gifted officers several sheng of rice and bolts only one zhang therefore men would not serve him and ruin followed.

value.zh: 及苟晞救鄴，桑還平陽。
value.en: Gou Xi's relief sent Ji Sang back toward Pingyang.
value.literal: When Gou Xi relieved Ye Sang returned to Pingyang.

value.zh: 于時盛夏，屍爛壞不可復識，騰及三子骸骨不獲。
value.en: It was midsummer, and the corpses had decayed beyond recognition; the remains of Teng and his three sons could not be recovered.
value.literal: It was then deep summer; corpses rotted beyond recognition and Teng's and his three sons' bones could not be recovered.

value.zh: 庶子確立。
value.en: His son by a secondary consort, Sima Que, succeeded him.
value.literal: His son by a secondary consort, Que, succeeded him.

value.zh: 南陽王模，字元表，少好學，與元帝及范陽王虓俱有稱於宗室。
value.en: Mo, styled Yuanbiao, studied hard alongside Sima Rui and Sima Xiao.
value.literal: Prince of Nanyang Mo courtesy Yuanbiao in youth loved learning and together with Yuan Di and Prince Xiao of Fanyang was praised within the imperial clan.

value.zh: 初封平昌公。
value.en: He began as Pingchang duke.
value.literal: At first enfeoffed Duke of Pingchang.

value.zh: 惠帝末，拜冗從僕射，累遷太子庶子、員外散騎常侍。
value.en: Late Hui's reign brought chariot master through heir staff to supernumerary cavalry attendant.
value.literal: Late Emperor Hui he was appointed supernumerary chariot master and progressively promoted heir-apparent household aide and supernumerary irregular cavalry attendant.

value.zh: 成都王穎奔長安，東海王越以模為北中郎將，鎮鄴。
value.en: Ying's flight west left Mo northern gentleman at Ye under Yue.
value.literal: When Prince of Chengdu Ying fled to Chang'an Prince of Donghai Yue appointed Mo Northern Gentlemen General guarding Ye.

value.zh: 永興初，成都王穎故帳下督公師籓、樓權、郝昌等攻鄴，模左右謀應之。
value.en: Yongxing opened with Gongshi Fan's siege and traitors inside Ye.
value.literal: Early Yongxing Chengdu Prince Ying's former overseer Gongshi Fan Lou Quan Hao Chang and others attacked Ye; Mo's attendants plotted to respond within.

value.zh: 廣平太守丁邵率眾救模，范陽王虓又遣兗州刺史苟晞援之，籓等散走。
value.en: Ding Shao and Gou Xi lifted the siege and routed Fan.
value.literal: Guangping governor Ding Shao led hosts relieving Mo; Prince Xiao of Fanyang again dispatched Yan Inspector Gou Xi aiding them; Fan and others scattered and fled.

value.zh: 遷鎮東大將軍，鎮許昌。
value.en: He became guarding-east marshal at Xuchang.
value.literal: Mo was promoted Guarding East Grand Marshal stationed Xuchang.

value.zh: 進爵南陽王。
value.en: Promoted to Prince of Nanyang.
value.literal: He advanced noble rank Prince of Nanyang.

value.zh: 永嘉初，轉征西大將軍、開府、都督秦雍梁益諸軍事，代河間王顒鎮關中。
value.en: Yongjia gave him four-province western command replacing Sima Yong.
value.literal: Early Yongjia he transferred western expedition grand marshal independent headquarters supervising Qin Yong Liang Yi military affairs replacing Prince of Hejian Yong guarding Guanzhong.

value.zh: 模感丁邵之德，敕國人為邵生立碑。
value.en: He memorialized Ding Shao with a standing stone.
value.literal: Mo grateful for Ding Shao's virtue ordered his people erect a living monument to Shao.

value.zh: 河間王顒表立成都王穎為太弟，為王浚所破，挾天子還洛陽。
value.en: Yong's heir plot collapsed under Wang Jun forcing return east.
value.literal: Prince of Hejian Yong memorialized establishing Chengdu Prince Ying heir-apparent; defeated by Wang Jun he escorted Son of Heaven back Luoyang.

value.zh: 虓與東平王楙、鎮東將軍周馥等上言曰：自湣懷被害，皇儲不建，委重前相，輒失臣節。
value.en: Xiao, together with King Mao of Dongping, General Who Guards the East Zhou Fu, and others, submitted words, saying: Since Minhuai was harmed, the imperial heir has not been established. Weighty responsibility was entrusted to the former minister, and he then lost the duty of a subject.
value.literal: Xiao, together with King Mao of Dongping, General Who Guards the East Zhou Fu, and others, submitted words, saying: Since Minhuai was harmed, the imperial heir has not been established. Weighty responsibility was entrusted to the former minister, and he then lost the duty of a subject.

value.zh: 是以前年太宰與臣，永惟社稷之貳，不可久空，所以共啟成都王穎，以為國副。
value.en: Therefore in the previous year the Grand Steward and we your servants long considered that the deputy of the altars of soil and grain could not remain vacant for long, and for this reason we jointly proposed King Ying of Chengdu to be deputy to the state.
value.literal: Therefore in the previous year the Grand Steward and we your servants long considered that the deputy of the altars of soil and grain could not remain vacant for long, and for this reason we jointly proposed King Ying of Chengdu to be deputy to the state.

value.zh: 受重之後，而弗克負荷。
value.en: After receiving this weighty charge, he was unable to bear it.
value.literal: After receiving this weighty charge, he was unable to bear it.

value.zh: 「小人勿用」，而以為腹心。
value.en: "Do not employ petty men," yet he made them his trusted intimates.
value.literal: "Do not employ petty men," yet he made them his trusted intimates.

value.zh: 骨肉宜敦，而猜佻薦至，險詖宜遠，而讒說殄行。
value.en: Flesh-and-blood kin should have been treated with thick affection, yet suspicion and frivolity arrived repeatedly; dangerous and slanting men should have been kept distant, yet slanderous talk destroyed conduct.
value.literal: Flesh-and-blood kin should have been treated with thick affection, yet suspicion and frivolity arrived repeatedly; dangerous and slanting men should have been kept distant, yet slanderous talk destroyed conduct.

value.zh: 此皆臣等不聰不明，失所宗賴。
value.en: All this was because we your servants were neither perceptive nor clear-sighted and lost the one on whom we relied.
value.literal: All this was because we your servants were neither perceptive nor clear-sighted and lost the one on whom we relied.

value.zh: 遂令陛下謬于降授，雖戮臣等，不足以謝天下。
value.en: We then caused Your Majesty to err in lowering and granting rank; even if you executed us, it would not be enough to apologize to all under Heaven.
value.literal: We then caused Your Majesty to err in lowering and granting rank; even if you executed us, it would not be enough to apologize to all under Heaven.

value.zh: 今大駕還宮，文武空曠，制度荒破，靡有孑遺，臣等雖劣，足匡王室。
value.en: Now the great carriage has returned to the palace, civil and military offices are empty, institutions are ruined and broken, and nothing remains. Although we your servants are inferior, we are enough to help correct the royal house.
value.literal: Now the great carriage has returned to the palace, civil and military offices are empty, institutions are ruined and broken, and nothing remains. Although we your servants are inferior, we are enough to help correct the royal house.

value.zh: 而道路之言，謂張方與臣等不同。
value.en: But talk on the roads says that Zhang Fang is not of one mind with us.
value.literal: But talk on the roads says that Zhang Fang is not of one mind with us.

value.zh: 既惜所在興異，又乙太宰惇德允元，著於具瞻，每當義節，輒為社稷宗盟之先。
value.en: We both regret that differences are arising where he is, and also because the Grand Steward is sincere in virtue and truly principal, visible to all who look up to him; whenever righteousness and integrity are at stake, he always stands first among the great allies of the altars of soil and grain.
value.literal: We both regret that differences are arising where he is, and also because the Grand Steward is sincere in virtue and truly principal, visible to all who look up to him; whenever righteousness and integrity are at stake, he always stands first among the great allies of the altars of soil and grain.

value.zh: 張方受其指教，為國效節。
value.en: Zhang Fang received his direction and instruction and showed integrity for the state.
value.literal: Zhang Fang received his direction and instruction and showed integrity for the state.

value.zh: 昔年之舉，有死無貳。
value.en: In last year's action, he had death before him and no second loyalty.
value.literal: In last year's action, he had death before him and no second loyalty.

value.zh: 此即太宰之良將，陛下之忠臣。
value.en: He is therefore a good general of the Grand Steward and a loyal subject of Your Majesty.
value.literal: He is therefore a good general of the Grand Steward and a loyal subject of Your Majesty.

value.zh: 但以受性強毅，不達變通，遂守前志，已致紛紜。
value.en: It is only because his nature is forceful and resolute and he does not understand adaptation that he kept to his former intention and has already caused confusion.
value.literal: It is only because his nature is forceful and resolute and he does not understand adaptation that he kept to his former intention and has already caused confusion.

value.zh: 然退思惟，既是其不易之節，且慮事翻之後，為天下所罪，故不即西還耳。
value.en: Yet when we withdraw and think on it, this is already his unchanging integrity, and he also worries that after affairs reverse, he will be blamed by all under Heaven; therefore he has not immediately returned west.
value.literal: Yet when we withdraw and think on it, this is already his unchanging integrity, and he also worries that after affairs reverse, he will be blamed by all under Heaven; therefore he has not immediately returned west.

value.zh: 原其本事，實無深責。
value.en: When the root of the matter is traced, there is in fact no deep blame.
value.literal: When the root of the matter is traced, there is in fact no deep blame.

value.zh: 臣聞先代明主，未嘗不全護功臣，令福流子孫。
value.en: We your servants have heard that enlightened rulers of earlier generations always preserved and protected meritorious ministers and made blessings flow to their descendants.
value.literal: We your servants have heard that enlightened rulers of earlier generations always preserved and protected meritorious ministers and made blessings flow to their descendants.

value.zh: 自中間以來，陛下功臣初無全者，非獨人才皆劣，其於取禍，實由朝廷策之失宜，不相容恕。
value.en: Since the recent troubled period, none of Your Majesty's meritorious ministers has been preserved. This is not only because the men were all inferior; their incurring disaster has truly come from the court's policies losing what was fitting and from failure to tolerate and forgive one another.
value.literal: Since the recent troubled period, none of Your Majesty's meritorious ministers has been preserved. This is not only because the men were all inferior; their incurring disaster has truly come from the court's policies losing what was fitting and from failure to tolerate and forgive one another.

value.zh: 以一旦之咎，喪其積年之勳，既違《周禮》議功之典，且使天下之人莫敢復為陛下致節者。
value.en: To lose accumulated years of merit because of one day's fault both violates the Zhouli canon of deliberating on merit and makes the people of the realm no longer dare to give their utmost loyalty for Your Majesty.
value.literal: To lose accumulated years of merit because of one day's fault both violates the Zhouli canon of deliberating on merit and makes the people of the realm no longer dare to give their utmost loyalty for Your Majesty.

value.zh: 臣等此言，豈獨為一張方，實為社稷遠計，欲令功臣長守富貴。
value.en: These words of ours are not only for one Zhang Fang; they are truly a long-range plan for the altars of soil and grain, wishing to let meritorious ministers long keep wealth and honor.
value.literal: These words of ours are not only for one Zhang Fang; they are truly a long-range plan for the altars of soil and grain, wishing to let meritorious ministers long keep wealth and honor.

value.zh: 臣愚以為宜委太宰以關右之任，一方事重，及自州郡已下，選舉授任，一皆仰成。
value.en: In our foolish view, it is fitting to entrust the Grand Steward with responsibility west of the passes. Affairs in that region are weighty, and from provinces and commanderies downward, selection, recommendation, appointment, and assignment should all look up to him for completion.
value.literal: In our foolish view, it is fitting to entrust the Grand Steward with responsibility west of the passes. Affairs in that region are weighty, and from provinces and commanderies downward, selection, recommendation, appointment, and assignment should all look up to him for completion.

value.zh: 若朝之大事，廢興損益，每輒疇諮。
value.en: As for great affairs of the court, abolitions, establishments, reductions, and additions, each should be consulted with him.
value.literal: As for great affairs of the court, abolitions, establishments, reductions, and additions, each should be consulted with him.

value.zh: 此則二伯述職，周召分陝之義，陛下復行於今時。
value.en: This would be Your Majesty carrying out again in the present age the meaning of the two regional chiefs reporting on their duties and of Zhou and Shao dividing Shaan.
value.literal: This would be Your Majesty carrying out again in the present age the meaning of the two regional chiefs reporting on their duties and of Zhou and Shao dividing Shaan.

value.zh: 遣方還郡，令群後申志，時定王室。
value.en: Send Fang back to his commandery, let the assembled nobles extend their intentions, and in time settle the royal house.
value.literal: Send Fang back to his commandery, let the assembled nobles extend their intentions, and in time settle the royal house.

value.zh: 所加方官，請悉如舊。
value.en: As for the offices added to Fang, we request that all be as before.
