value.literal: As for the offices added to Fang, we request that all be as before.

value.zh: 此則忠臣義士有勸，功臣必全矣。
value.en: Then loyal ministers and righteous men will have encouragement, and meritorious ministers will surely be preserved.
value.literal: Then loyal ministers and righteous men will have encouragement, and meritorious ministers will surely be preserved.

value.zh: 司徒戎，異姓之賢；
value.en: Minister over the Masses Rong is a worthy of a different surname.
value.literal: Minister over the Masses Rong is a worthy of a different surname.

value.zh: 司空越，公族之望，並忠國愛主，小心翼翼，宜幹機事，委以朝政。
value.en: Minister of Works Yue is the hope of the imperial clan. Both are loyal to the state and love the ruler, careful and reverent, and should manage key affairs and be entrusted with court government.
value.literal: Minister of Works Yue is the hope of the imperial clan. Both are loyal to the state and love the ruler, careful and reverent, and should manage key affairs and be entrusted with court government.

value.zh: 安北將軍王浚佐命之胤，率身履道，忠亮清正，遠近所推。
value.en: General Who Pacifies the North Wang Jun is a descendant of one who assisted the mandate; he leads himself according to the Way, is loyal, bright, clear, and correct, and is recommended by those near and far.
value.literal: General Who Pacifies the North Wang Jun is a descendant of one who assisted the mandate; he leads himself according to the Way, is loyal, bright, clear, and correct, and is recommended by those near and far.

value.zh: 如今日之大舉，實有定社稷之勳，此是臣等所以歎息歸高也。
value.en: In a great undertaking like today's, he truly has merit in settling the altars of soil and grain; this is why we sigh in admiration and return high praise to him.
value.literal: In a great undertaking like today's, he truly has merit in settling the altars of soil and grain; this is why we sigh in admiration and return high praise to him.

value.zh: 浚宜特崇重之，以副群望，遂撫幽朔，長為北籓。
value.en: Jun should be specially exalted and honored in order to meet the hopes of the multitude, then pacify You and the northern lands and long serve as the northern shield.
value.literal: Jun should be specially exalted and honored in order to meet the hopes of the multitude, then pacify You and the northern lands and long serve as the northern shield.

value.zh: 臣等竭力扞城，籓屏皇家，陛下垂拱，而四海自正。
value.en: We your servants will exhaust our strength as defending walls and act as screens for the imperial house, while Your Majesty lets your robes hang and folds your hands, and the four seas will correct themselves.
value.literal: We your servants will exhaust our strength as defending walls and act as screens for the imperial house, while Your Majesty lets your robes hang and folds your hands, and the four seas will correct themselves.

value.zh: 則四祖之業，必隆於今，日月之暉，昧而復曜。
value.en: Then the enterprise of the Four Ancestors will surely flourish today, and the radiance of sun and moon, once dimmed, will shine again.
value.literal: Then the enterprise of the Four Ancestors will surely flourish today, and the radiance of sun and moon, once dimmed, will shine again.

value.zh: 乞垂三思，察臣所言。
value.en: We beg you to lower threefold thought and examine what we your servants have said.
value.literal: We beg you to lower threefold thought and examine what we your servants have said.

value.zh: 又可以臣表西示太宰。
value.en: You may also show our memorial westward to the Grand Steward.
value.literal: You may also show our memorial westward to the Grand Steward.

value.zh: 又表曰：「成都王失道，為奸邪所誤，論王之身，不宜深責。
value.en: Again memorializing 'Chengdu Prince lost the Way misled by wicked favorites judging the prince's person ought not be deeply blamed.
value.literal: Again memorializing 'Chengdu Prince lost the Way misled by wicked favorites judging the prince's person ought not be deeply blamed.

value.zh: 且先帝遺體，陛下群弟，自元康以來，罪戮相等，實海內所為匈匈，而臣等所以痛心。
value.en: Moreover former emperor's bodily heirs Your Majesty's junior brothers since Yuankang executions match in toll truly why realm churns and why we ache.
value.literal: Moreover former emperor's bodily heirs Your Majesty's junior brothers since Yuankang executions match in toll truly why realm churns and why we ache.

value.zh: 今廢成都，更封一邑，宜其必許。
value.en: Now deposing Chengdu changing enfeoffment one canton he ought surely consent.
value.literal: Now deposing Chengdu changing enfeoffment one canton he ought surely consent.

value.zh: 若廢黜尋有禍害，既傷陛下矜慈之恩，又令遠近恆謂公族無復骨肉之情，此實臣等內省悲慚，無顏于四海也。
value.en: If deposition soon brings calamity it wounds Your Majesty's compassionate grace and lets far and near forever say the ducal kin lack flesh-and-blood feeling—truly our inward shame without face before the realm.
value.literal: If deposition soon brings calamity it wounds Your Majesty's compassionate grace and lets far and near forever say the ducal kin lack flesh-and-blood feeling—truly our inward shame without face before the realm.

value.zh: 乞陛下察臣忠款。」
value.en: We beg Your Majesty to perceive our loyal sincerity."
value.literal: We beg Your Majesty to perceive our loyal sincerity."

value.zh: 於是虓先率眾自許屯于滎陽。
value.en: Xiao marched to Xingyang first.
value.literal: Thereupon Xiao first led hosts from Xu camping at Xingyang.

value.zh: 濟南惠王遂，字子伯，宣帝弟魏鴻臚丞恂之子也。
value.en: Sima Sui, styled Zibo, was Sima Xun's son—Sima Yi's nephew.
value.literal: Prince Hui of Jinan Sui courtesy Zibo was son of Emperor Xuan's younger brother Wei Grand Herald Assistant Xun.

value.zh: 仕魏關內侯，進封平昌亭侯，曆典軍郎將，
value.en: Under Wei he rose from secondary marquis to Pingchang ting through army posts.
value.literal: Serving Wei district marquis within passes advanced Marquis of Pingchang precinct successively holding army corps captain.

value.zh: 景元二年，轉封武城鄉侯、督鄴城守諸軍事、北中郎將。
value.en: In the second year of Jingyuan, Shifted to Wucheng township marquis guarding Ye as northern gentleman.
value.literal: In the second year of Jingyuan, Transferred enfeoffment Wucheng village marquis supervising Ye garrison Northern Gentlemen General.

value.zh: 五等建，封祝阿伯，累遷冠軍將軍。
value.en: Five-rank reform made him Zhu'e baron then champion general.
value.literal: When five ranks were established enfeoffed Baron of Zhu'e progressively Champion General.

value.zh: 武帝受禪，封濟南王。
value.en: Sima Yan created Jinan prince.
value.literal: When Emperor Wu accepted the abdication he was enfeoffed Prince of Jinan.

value.zh: 泰始二年薨。
value.en: He died in the second year of Taishi.
value.literal: In the second year of Taishi, he died.

value.zh: 二子：耽、緝。
value.en: Sons Dan and Ji.
value.literal: Two sons: Dan and Ji.

value.zh: 耽嗣立，咸寧三年徙為中山王。
value.en: Dan succeeded to the title, and in Xianning year three he was transferred to be Prince of Zhongshan.
value.literal: Dan succeeded to the title, and in Xianning year three he was transferred to be Prince of Zhongshan.

value.zh: 是年薨，無子，緝繼。
value.en: Dan died childless same year; Ji followed.
value.literal: Same year died without sons Ji continued.

value.zh: 成都王穎以緝為建威將軍，與石熙等率眾距王浚，沒於陣，薨。
value.en: Ying named Ji bulwark general alongside Shi Xi to stop Wang Jun; Ji died on the field.
value.literal: Prince of Chengdu Ying appointed Ji bulwark general leading hosts with Shi Xi resisting Wang Jun perishing in battle.

value.zh: 無子，國除。
value.en: Without heirs the principality ended.
value.literal: Having no sons state abolished.

value.zh: 魏舒，字陽元，任城樊人也。
value.en: Wei Shu, whose courtesy name was Yangyuan, came from Fan in Rencheng commandery.
value.literal: Wei Shu, courtesy name Yangyuan, was a man of Fan in Rencheng.

value.zh: 少孤，為外家寧氏所養。
value.en: He lost his father while still young and was brought up by his mother's people, the Nings.
value.literal: In youth he was orphaned and was reared by his maternal kin, the Ning clan.

value.zh: 寧氏起宅，相宅者云：「當出貴甥。」
value.en: When the Nings raised a new house, a geomancer told them, "This site will produce a distinguished nephew."
value.literal: The Ning family built a house, and a geomancer of the site said, "A noble nephew will come forth."

value.zh: 外祖母以魏氏甥小而慧，意謂應之。
value.en: His maternal grandmother, seeing that the Wei boy was young but bright, assumed the omen pointed to him.
value.literal: His maternal grandmother, because the Wei nephew was small yet clever, in her mind thought it referred to him.

value.zh: 舒曰：「當為外氏成此宅相。」
value.en: Shu said, "It falls to me to fulfill that houselot prophecy for our mother's family."
value.literal: Shu said, "I shall for the maternal clan complete this houselot omen."

value.zh: 久乃別居。
value.en: Only after many years did he move out and keep a separate household.
value.literal: After a long time then he lived apart.
